description: What obligations does this entity's Corporate Integrity Agreement actually impose — Board Resolution, Independent Review Organization (IRO) reviews, Compliance Officer/Committee, Annual/Implementation reporting, a disclosure program, excluded-persons screening? Resolves the entity (same matching as oig_cia_check) or takes a direct document_url (from oig_cia_check's agreement_url field), fetches the agreement PDF LIVE from oig.hhs.gov, extracts its text, and reports which of those obligation categories appear in the text with a short excerpt for each. Not every CIA includes every category — a sole-individual CIA typically has no Board Resolution clause, and some older closed agreements have no PDF posted at all (reported as found:false, not an error). Sourced from HHS-OIG, keyless.

document_url.description: A specific agreement PDF URL under oig.hhs.gov/documents/cias/..., e.g. from a prior oig_cia_check call's agreement_url field. Overrides name-based lookup when given.

name.description: Company or individual name to look up (resolved the same way as oig_cia_check). Omit if passing document_url directly.
